one_liner: Bright Data offers self-serve API credentials, documented HTTP APIs, and an official MCP server for web data access.

auth.notes: The username-and-password option is for native proxy access, not the recommended API integration path.

access.notes: New accounts receive an API key and 5,000 recurring monthly credits for listed APIs without a credit card. The allowance excludes proxy products, which have separate time-limited trial credit. The self-serve path uses Bright Data's hosted services; a locally run MCP connector does not self-host the underlying platform.

api.notes: Public documentation covers HTTP scraping and other product APIs, including search, browsers, and account management.

mcp.notes: Bright Data documents a usable managed remote server and a locally run connector.

verdict.rationale: New accounts receive an API key and recurring credits for documented APIs. The free allowance has usage limits and excludes proxy products.

evidence.quote: Authenticate with Bright Data using 1 of 2 methods: API Access with an API key or Native Access with proxy username and password.
An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API.
New accounts receive an API key in the Bright Data welcome email. Use that key for this guide.

Every new Bright Data account gets 5,000 free credits per month (~$7.50 value), usable across the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API. No credit card, no promo code, no commitment.
You can run the server two ways: a fully managed remote server, or a self-hosted local instance.
The same call works for every one of Bright Data’s thousands of pre-built scrapers: change the dataset_id over HTTP, or call a different method in the SDK.
Guides, quickstarts and API references for Bright Data Scraper API, Scraper Studio, Web Unlocker API, SERP API, proxies, datasets and Bright Data MCP.

The Bright Data MCP server gives AI agents and assistants real-time access to public web data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Connect it to Claude, Cursor or any MCP-compatible client, and your agent can search, scrape and read live web pages without you building or maintaining data pipelines.
Bright Data provides the world's #1 web data platform with Web Unlocker for bypassing anti-bot systems, SERP API for search engine data, and pre-made scrapers for popular websites.

Every new Bright Data account gets 5,000 free credits per month (~$7.50 value), usable across the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API. No credit card, no promo code, no commitment.
